verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Plaid Identity Verification performs liveness and face matching, so it processes biometric data. Nothing in the evidence pack documents GDPR lawful bases, BIPA or other US biometric statutes, or required consent language. The only related item is the liveness feature claim, which is adjacent to the story and does not cover the legal-handling documentation it asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor documents how biometric data is handled lawfully — GDPR bases, US biometric statutes like BIPA, and the consent language my flow needs — so legal review has something to review
